source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting results that contradict the hypothesis in a psychology research report

1. Start with the research records.
2.
completion:
Measure the data accurately.
3. Type the raw data.
4. Find the right measure.

5. Tweak the design as needed.
6. Check out the literature.
7. Redo the analysis as appropriate.
8. Consult with an advisor.

9. Take out the suggested measures.
10. Write the introduction.
11. Provide a detailed account of data analysis.
12. Write the conclusion.

13. Make sure the conclusion is phrased in as strong a language as the data will allow.
14. Take some time.  Do it all again.
15. Write the manuscript.  Have someone else review it.
16. Use the feedback to rewrite the manuscript.

17. Submit.  Go back and tweak the analyses as needed.
18. Resubmit.  Consult with your advisor.  Repeat revisions and resub
